blue_stripes_commando.name: Blue Stripes Commando

udalryk.flavour: Haaaargh! After me, if ye've the bollocks!

war_longship.name: War Longship
war_longship.flavour: They say Hemdall's heart swells whenever the longships sail out on a raid.

frost.name: Biting Frost
frost.flavour: Best part about frost - bodies of the fallen don't rot so quickly.

cirilla_fiona_elen_riannon.name: Cirilla Fiona Elen Riannon
cirilla_fiona_elen_riannon.flavour: Know when fairy tales cease to be tales? When people start believing in them.

clear.name: Clear Weather
clear.flavour: The sun's shinin', Dromle! The sun's shinin'! Maybe there's hope left after all...

horn.name: Commander's Horn
horn.flavour: Plus one to morale, minus three to hearing.

dandelion.name: Dandelion
dandelion.flavour: Dandelion, you're a cynic, a lecher, a whoremonger, a liar - and my best friend.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.flavour: When you run out of peasants, decoys also make decent arrow fodder.

emiel_regis_rohellec_terzieff.name: Emiel Regis Rohellec Terzieff
emiel_regis_rohellec_terzieff.flavour: Men, the polite ones, at least, would call me a monster. A blood-drinking freak.

gaunter_odimm.name: Gaunter O'Dimm
gaunter_odimm.flavour: He always grants exactly what you wish for. That's the problem.

gaunter_odimm_darkness.name: Gaunter O'Dimm: Darkness
gaunter_odimm_darkness.flavour: Fear not the shadows, but the light.

geralt_of_rivia.name: Geralt of Rivia
geralt_of_rivia.flavour: If that's what it takes to save the world, it'd better to let that world die.

fog.name: Impenetrable Fog
fog.flavour: A good commander's dream... a bad one's horror.

olgierd_von_everec.name: Olgierd von Everec
olgierd_von_everec.flavour: At least you now know I don't easily lose my head

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.flavour: Pillars of flame turn the mightiest to ash. All others tremble in shock and awe.

storm.name: Skellige Storm
storm.flavour: This ain't no normal storm. This here's the wrath of the gods.

rain.name: Torrential Rain
rain.flavour: Even the rain in this land smells like piss.

triss_merigold.name: Triss Merigold
triss_merigold.flavour: I can take care of myself. Trust me.

vesemir.name: Vesemir
vesemir.flavour: If you're to be hanged, ask for water. Anything can happen before they fetch it.

villentretenmerth.name: Villentretenmerth
villentretenmerth.flavour: Also calls himself Borkh Three Jackdaws... he's not the best at names.

yennefer_of_vengerberg.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
yennefer_of_vengerberg.flavour: Magic is Chaos, Art and Science. It is a curse, a blessing and a progression.

zoltan_chivay.name: Zoltan Chivay
zoltan_chivay.flavour: Life without old mates and booze is like a woman without a rump.
